# Source: Shiva as Lord of the Dance (Nataraja)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Shiva as Lord of the Dance (Nataraja)
- **Artist / culture:** India Tamil Nadu
- **Date:** Chola period, about 10th/11th century
- **Style:** South Asian
- **Classification:** bronze
- **Department:** Arts of Asia
- **AIC artwork ID:** 24548
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/24548
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/cf50f037-5fb2-e197-0e56-3ae701edb3e2/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Dance

## Extracted source palette

`#B8B8B8, #989898, #888878, #787858, #585838, #D8D8D8, #B8A888, #383828`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#2E2E1D`
- `surface`: `#464637`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B8A888`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#383828`
- `surface_variant`: `#464637`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#67675A`
- `error`: `#B8A888`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `12.95:1`, surface `9.01:1`
- Variant contrast: `9.01:1`
- Control contrast: `8.37:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
